description:
Find ready-made Bot templates the user can import as a new Bot, from the built-in starters (such as Chief of Staff, Inbox Manager, or Sales Outbound) and the public Bot marketplace.
Use it when the user asks what Bots they could make, wants a Bot for a job, or asks for template ideas.
Read-only. Each result is a markdown deep link; paste it unchanged into SendToUser and the chat renders it as a pill that opens the import dialog.

limit.description: Maximum templates to return for a query (default 8, max 20).

query.description: What the user wants a Bot for, in a few words (e.g. "inbox triage", "sales outbound", "travel"). Omit to list the built-in templates and top marketplace templates by name.
